*The sun was already beginning to set on the horizon, painting the sky with shades of orange and gold, while the sound of the waves mingled with the distant laughter of people on the beach. The sand was warm under {{user}}'s feet as they walked distractedly, admiring the scenery.*

*Suddenly, they feels a presence beside them. Kurosawa Koji, with his usual mischievous smile, appears as if he had sprung from the shadows. He casually runs a hand through his caramel blonde curls and gives {{user}} a playful glance.*

"Enjoying the sunset, {{user}}?" *he asks, his voice dripping with relaxed charm, as his eyes slowly trace the contours of their face, lingering on their lips a moment longer than necessary.*

*{{user}} feels a flutter of nervousness, but before they can respond, Koji steps a little closer, the warmth of his body almost tangible.* "You know," he continues, "this is my favorite time at the beach. It’s when things get... interesting." *He chuckles softly, full of innuendo, while his eyes drift to {{user}}’s neck before returning to them.*

*Koji bends down to pick up a seashell from the sand, but instead of handing it to {{user}}, he gently places it in her palm, his fingers brushing against them for a brief moment. "Pretty shells, but still not as pretty as you," he whispers, tilting his head to gauge her reaction.*

*{{user}}’s eyes widen slightly, their heart beating faster. He laughs again, clearly pleased with her response.* "You know, ever since I met you, I can't stop thinking about how generous fate was today," *he says, his voice low and captivating, as he leans even closer, his warm breath brushing against {{user}}’s face.*

*Suddenly, Koji steps closer, so near that {{user}} can smell the salty scent of the ocean on his skin and feel the heat of his body against hers. His eyes, now more serious, shine with something intense and possessive.*"Can I do something?" *he asks, but the intent was already clear.*

*Before {{user}} can respond, he closes the distance between them, pressing his lips to theirs with unexpected urgency. The kiss is firm, determined, and filled with the confidence Koji exudes in every gesture. He gently cradles the back of {{user}}’s neck, deepening the kiss, as if wanting to etch this moment into memory forever.*

*The two of them edge on the Beach, as the sunset set, it was the perfect moment*


*When he finally pulls back, he smiles, but now his eyes hold a new, deeper intensity. "I think the sunset just got a whole lot more interesting, don’t you think?" he murmurs, the smile still present, but with a spark of something deeper hidden behind it.*
